runtime.note: Verified locally on Node 26; the supported baseline remains Node 22.x (engines, .nvmrc, CI, Docker). CI on the pull request runs Node 22.

security.scanner: Targeted pattern scan (Gitleaks was not available on the release machine for 0.2.0)
security.scope: Every publication file except Git internals, node_modules and dist
patterns: cloud and SaaS tokens (AWS, GitHub, Slack, Google, Anthropic/OpenAI style)
Salesforce session and refresh tokens, consumer keys longer than placeholders
local user paths and personal contact details
security.findings: No credentials or personal data. Only placeholder URLs (user:password@localhost), synthetic test consumer keys, and third-party author emails inside their own retained license texts.

notVerified: Docker build/publication and exact binary-artifact attribution
Historical development credential reuse outside reviewed archive

remaining.scope: tsx dev toolchain, Windows dev server only, not shipped
